rs.innovation_approach: 在统一多轮工具协议下组合检索与局部视觉查看；7B先用困难题合成轨迹冷启动，再用先组内、后优化器minibatch标准化的序列级BN-GSPO训练；Qwen3系8B/32B省略SFT。
rs.key_step: 把每条完整交互轨迹的正确性+格式奖励先做组内mean/std，再对该优势做minibatch mean/std，以长度归一化序列重要性比裁剪更新。
rs.why_non_obvious: 作者将多工具轨迹的长度/奖励/难度异质性视为GSPO不稳定来源；但第二次标准化何时提供额外信息取决于minibatch组构成和零方差处理，论文没有给出这些实现细节。后半句为读者推断。
rs.trigger_condition: When a policy must interleave external retrieval and local inspection with heterogeneous tool trajectories, apply a shared interaction protocol and group-then-minibatch normalized sequence optimization to train coordinated tool use.
rs.acceptance_signal: low_evidence: manifest decision=null copied exactly; no review source located in the local manifest/candidate/inventory context. This reading makes no acceptance inference.
rs.abstract_strategy: Train a shared sequential controller over complementary information sources, then normalize sequence feedback at two aggregation levels.
rs.abstract_key_step: Standardize each local comparison group, restandardize the resulting signals within an optimizer batch, and clip a length-normalized sequence likelihood ratio.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: Separate access to complementary evidence sources does not itself teach coordinated control; a second normalization also requires checking whether the first has already removed the variation it targets.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When heterogeneous interaction paths destabilize a shared controller, normalize their feedback at the declared aggregation levels and verify which variation survives each stage.

question.observed_failure: AppD/Fig10报告Qwen2.5-VL-7B调用中96.2%为text search、3.7%为image search，crop近乎不用；V*总工具调用7次，trained 7B为341次。Table3标准GSPO在V*/HR4K仅53.93/44.50，而BN-GSPO为79.05/69.12。前者是工具偏置观察，后者是算法对比，未证明同一因果链。
question.load_bearing_assumption: 把search能力、image manipulation能力分开训练或仅给工具，再沿用标准序列优化，足以形成稳定的跨工具协调策略。作者挑战这一工程默认，未提出不可能性定理。
question.scope: 有search、image search与crop的多轮图文问答，涉及外部知识和高分辨率感知；主要为Qwen系列7B/8B/32B。
question.success_criterion: search与高分辨率perception多benchmark准确率、无SFT算法对照及数据组成消融；调用次数是描述性指标，未预设准确率非劣+最少crop判据。

objective.signal_routing: 正确性和格式分相加后仅产生序列级优势，作用于整个序列ratio；没有逐轮/逐crop差分、反事实信用或caption独立信号。由ratio公式，参与求和的log-prob共享同一优势并受1/|y|长度缩放（读者推导）。论文把trajectory描述为含observations，但未给出assistant/observation/vision-token loss mask或length计数契约，故不能认定工具返回token被训练或被mask。KL对reference策略；token聚合/估计方式未给出。
objective.normalization: mean+std within each prompt group (Eq2), then mean+std over optimizer minibatch advantages (Eq3); length-normalized sequence likelihood ratio. NOT batch normalization instead of group std; NOT RLOO or mean-only.
objective.invariance: 不是PBRS，也没有最优策略不变性证明。读者代数推断：对每个非零方差group，reward的正仿射变换r→a_b r+c_b在Eq2后不变（忽略未说明的epsilon）；全对且格式恒定时引入λ crop成本会同样被组std约掉，Eq3无法恢复已消失的λ。若batch正好由等大完整非退化groups组成且均用总体std，Eq3为恒等变换；若样本std则可为统一有限样本尺度因子。零方差组、group拆分、mask或epsilon均会改变这一结论，论文未报告足够实现细节。
objective.baseline_or_potential: baseline为同题G条rollout的reward均值，含自身，非leave-one-out；第二层中心为minibatch的group-normalized advantage均值。无critic、MC状态fork或势函数。外部裁判训练身份正文/附录冲突（GPT-4o vs Qwen2.5-VL-72B）；π_ref冻结但具体checkpoint未指明。
objective.degenerate_cases: 按印刷公式，同reward组（全对且格式相同、全错且格式相同、G=1）std=0使Eq2未定义；论文未写epsilon/跳过规则，不能填为已实现zero。全对/全错但格式不同仍可有仅格式学习信号。若实现约定常数组优势为0且完整groups批均值0，此类组不获得正确性信用；若minibatch拆组其再中心化可能改变零值（条件性推断）。p(action)≈0时无强制采样或显式支持保护；Clip-Higher只可能影响已采样动作，非支撑保证。单轮仍是sequence ratio目标，不退化为crop必要性信号。

evidence_design.discriminating_experiment: 作者Table3在相同Qwen2.5-VL-7B起点、不做SFT下比较GRPO/GSPO/BN-GSPO，是最接近隔离归一化改动的实验。尚缺训练预算、G、minibatch构成、种子和有效梯度尺度，不能将准确率差独立归因为跨prompt reward-scale校正。
controls: Table3 pure RL: GRPO vs GSPO vs BN-GSPO; same stated base, no cold-start.
Table4: 7B-SFT baseline versus search-only, perception-only and hybrid RL data. Hybrid V*=83.84 is below perception-only85.24, so hybrid is not best on every metric.
Tables1–2: direct answer and agentic workflows; models, tool permissions and benchmark metrics must remain separate.
No reported random-region intervention, crop necessity labels, forced first-action support, constant-logit-bias control or accuracy noninferiority test.
AppendixD Fig10: training call-frequency trend and cross-model benchmark absolute counts are different comparisons.

evidence_design.falsifier: 读者提出而非作者执行：先在保存的同一reward batch上核对Eq2→Eq3是否只有恒等/全局尺度变化，明确group拆分与零方差约定；再在匹配token/rollout预算及多种子下比较GSPO与BN-GSPO。若正确对齐后优势无额外变化或收益不能复现，则否定“额外跨group标准化解释性能收益”的因果归因。若降低调用只来自提前错答，则不支持本课题非劣效率目标。
evidence_design.unreported: 训练种子数、训练重复次数及置信区间未报告。Avg@8是每题八次评估而不是八个训练种子；Appendix C.4同时说全评估temperature=0和用Avg@8降低sampling-temperature方差，随机来源未解释。

pitfalls.text: 标准GSPO在多工具异质轨迹上表现不均，作者以两级归一化处理，但实现边界未提供。
pitfalls.quote: Different prompts or tool interactions within the same batch can result in varying outcome lengths, reward scales, and difficulty levels, which may bias the learning signal and destabilize training.

pitfalls.text: 作者为避免在线搜索训练成本改成本地检索，并保持与推理相同摘要接口；省钱幅度未报告。
pitfalls.quote: During RL training, we avoid the prohibitive cost of live web searches by using a locally hosted Wikipedia knowledge base built from the 20250901 dump file (enwiki-20250901-pages-articles.xml.bz2).

engineering.lesson: 当多轮工具RL更改优势归一化时，应先记录group→optimizer minibatch的映射、有效token mask与零方差约定；否则两次标准化可能仅改变全局梯度尺度，且不能恢复已被第一层组std消去的成本系数。此为读者从Eq2–4推导的工程检查，并非作者已做实验。

relevance.how: 直接核对候选迁移假设：先group std再batch std，不能作为规避λ被约掉的已有解法。
sequence比率使用1/|y|几何平均，与token-mean loss不同；可作归一化对照，但长度与工具返回mask未给出，非固定分母无偏修复。
同题结果/格式优势仍作用于整个轨迹，未提供逐crop必要性或区别冗余与有效调用的信用信号。
7B用困难题工具轨迹SFT启动行为；8B/32B依赖基座工具能力而省略SFT。可迁移行为覆盖审计，不证明所有新行为都必须SFT。
AppD有训练内tool calls约4→2的趋势，但只描述7B且没有多种子/长程漂移或非劣效率检验。
提供V*全191、HR4K/8K各800、MME-RW23599的评测口径及Avg@8/Pass@1区别；HR-MMSearch包含外部检索任务，不能直接替换我们的crop-only任务。
搜索/感知混合训练数据消融表明任务配比影响跨域性能，但不是按当前策略crop收益分层。

source_gaps.detail: Main text says GPT-4o for both rewards; Appendix says Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct in all RL experiments. Evaluation GPT-4o is separately specified.
Perception-only search scores exceed SFT, contradicting prose major-drop claim; hybrid is also worse than perception-only on V*.
4849−1115=3734, while remaining is stated3695; difference39 not explained. Do not silently repair author counts.
Main text says image index argument; prompt image_search schema has empty properties and says no arguments. Crop index schema is explicit and supports previous crop images.
G, epsilon, sample/population std, complete-vs-split optimizer groups, masks, ratio length counting, optimizer epochs/reuse and reference initialization missing.
All evaluations temperature0 versus eight independent attempts described as reducing temperature variance; no stochasticity source or seed count given.
Main text promises detailed appendix hyperparameters, but no additional G/train-temperature/full-step-count table found in complete appendix.

benchmark_design.name: HR-MMSearch
benchmark_design.images: 4K 2025 images from Reuters, AP and CNBC, eight domains; questions target subjects smaller than 5% image area.
benchmark_design.annotation: Three bachelor-level annotators; three additional master-level-or-above experts cross-verify labels and answers (Appendix B.1).
benchmark_design.difficulty: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct agentic pass@8:188 hard (zero successful attempts),117 easy (at least one success);17 hard questions reportedly require all three tools. This is model/protocol-relative empirical difficulty, not intrinsic crop necessity.
benchmark_design.leakage_boundary: Authors intend recent-event filtering to reduce pretraining leakage; no independent contamination audit or model-specific training-cutoff proof reported.
